operations.ADD_css_atelier_p5_block: ~110 lines (data-magnet, data-reveal, data-stagger, .page.is-entering @keyframes atelierPageEnter, .u-cursor-glow, view-transition-name page-active, prefers-reduced-motion guards)
operations.ADD_iife_upg_choreo: ~115 lines (magnetize, reveal IO, stagger IO, cursorGlow, refresh)
operations.ADD_iife_upg_transition: ~70 lines (View Transitions API support detection, fallback .is-entering animation, [data-page] click delegation respecting legacy onclick)
operations.AUGMENT_html: 10 data-reveal cells (1 greet + 4 stat-tiles + 4 bento cells + 1 dock), 3 data-stagger containers (skill-grid, activity-list, dock-row), 6 data-magnet on dock-btns

behaviors_added: Hover on .dock-btn → button magnetically pulls toward cursor up to ~14px (0.18 strength × 80px range)
Bento greet + 4 stat-tiles + 4 bento cells + dock animate from opacity 0/translateY(12px) to visible when entering viewport (IntersectionObserver, threshold 0.05)
Skill grid (#cath-skill-grid) staggers children with 60ms step; activity list with 40ms step; dock row with 80ms step
Click on any [data-page] without inline onclick triggers Upg.transition.navigate → uses View Transitions API where supported, falls back to .is-entering CSS animation (atelierPageEnter spring 360ms)
Legacy onclick='navigateTo(...)' nav-items continue to work (delegation skips them to avoid double-fire)
After page transition, Upg.choreo.refresh() re-applies magnet/reveal/stagger to the newly visible page
All motion is gated by prefers-reduced-motion; reduced users see content instantly
